name: RCA CTDPFA salinity calibration, Cabled-07 SKQ201610S (2016)

annotations.annotation: Due to errors during vendor calibration, a calibration offset (CC_offset) of 9.6 is being applied during the on-demand creation of the L1 Seawater Pressure (dbar) data product from this instrument. For more information please contact help@oceanobservatories.org.
Parameters: corrected_dissolved_oxygen, ext_volt0. Suspect values due to possible sensor malfunction.

rca:cruise.definition: cast_time = midpoint of NMEA cast start (.cnv header) and the last bottle closure (.btl)
